philosophy	Tiger Style	docs/standards/source/idioms.adoc	78	External Rust idioms are accepted only when they encode a Tiger Style contract. Newtypes name units, capabilities, and secrets. RAII guards mediate resources. Contained unsafe modules keep invariants auditable. Borrowed argument types avoid needless ownership. Temporary mutability narrows mutation windows. Recoverable consumed-argument errors preserve retry paths. FFI wrappers and explicit error mapping keep foreign callers from owning Rust lifetimes. Restrained `Deref` avoids inheritance-shaped APIs.

A bundle is valid only when all required sidecars for its `output_format` are present and no extra sidecar file is present: `human` => only `command.txt`, `status.json`, `summary.txt`; `json` => only those files plus `results.jsonl`; `sarif` => only those files plus `results.sarif`.

A bundle is valid only when all required sidecars for its `output_format` are present and no extra sidecar file is present: `human` => only `command.txt`, `status.json`, `summary.txt`; `json` => only those files plus `results.jsonl`; `sarif` => only those files plus `results.sarif`.
